source_row.rationale: Serum chloride often changes in tandem with sodium and reflects overall fluid/electrolyte and acid-base balance. Low chloride (hypochloremia) can occur with conditions such as significant vomiting (loss of gastric chloride-rich fluid) or certain metabolic disturbances, and is often interpreted alongside sodium, bicarbonate, and overall clinical context rather than in isolation.
